text:
Alex P: quick proposal — surface per-route SLO presets in the console and make them cascade to fallbacks. idea: preset (recommended) -> tenant override -> global fallback. want to debate routing, quotas, telemetry for a safe rollout. cc @Priya S for UX.

Priya S: high-level ok. main UX question: how many presets? too many will confuse users. can we do 3 (low/standard/strict) + custom? :thinking_face:

Maria L: telemetry needs called out. we must show token-level latency histograms + sampled request traces in the same view, otherwise ops will spam paging. also need a canary sample size calc.

Jordan T: API concern — this should be API-first. console can read/write v2 route config. otherwise we'll end up with UI-only state that conflicts with infra. proposing a small shape for route SLOs: 
```json
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "slo": {
    "preset": "standard",
    "threshold_ms": 250,
    "error_budget": 0.01,
    "fallback_route": "route:best-effort"
  }
}
```

Priya S: that shape seems fine. UX wants a compact card: preset badge, numeric threshold, and "override" link. also a preview that shows estimated pages/day and noise-risk.

Alex P: +1 to API-first. rollout plan thought: ship console controls that only edit a staging flag. add a "preview impact" button that runs the batch sim on last 7d and shows projected alert delta + cost delta. then enable gradual rollout to 10% routes, 50%, 100%.

Maria L: for preview sim we need consistent telemetry windows and sampling. Suggest: use 7d, 95th latency, and count of unique tenants affected. add a note about quiet windows and maintenance windows. Default soft-threshold should be 5% less aggressive than preset to avoid noise on first rollout.

Jordan T: quota interaction — if a tenant has a low quota we should route alerts to secondary on-call instead of global paging. Should be policy-level: "slo_notify_route": ["primary", "secondary_if_quota_low"].

Alex P: good point. We should also add a hook for routing policies: priority by (tenant_quota_remaining, region, service_tier). Fallback to global if none match.

devex-bot: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/slo-routing-proposal (draft) — added schema and sim tool link.

Priya S: small nit — what about per-route sample sizes? if a route has <100 requests/day, don't surface an SLO by default, show "insufficient data" and suggest an aggregated SLO.

Maria L: agree. Also add auto-suppression where alerts are muted for the first X minutes after a deploy. will reduce noise.

Jordan T: quick API sketch for notify policy: 
```json
{
  "notify_policy": {
    "priority_keys": ["quota_remaining","region","tier"],
    "fallbacks": ["team:infra","team:serving"],
    "suppress_after_deploy_minutes": 15
  }
}
```

Alex P: sounds actionable. next steps: Jordan take API PR for v2 route schema, Maria add telemetry sim knobs, Priya mock the card / preview UX, I'll draft the rollout checklist. meet Thurs 11am for sync?

Priya S: works for me.

Maria L: yep. I'll add suggested histograms and sampling rates to the doc.

Jordan T: will open the API PR today and link back.

alert-bot: Deploy canary: slo-routing-sim v0.1 -> canary (5% of routes) :rocket:

Alex P: thanks — ping this thread when canary metrics are in, I'll review noise delta and rollback criteria. :thumbsup:
